scope.object: Actual first-step bare precision, original final Lambda1 and S1*, variable-slot support after the original selected reconstruction, and the declared fixed-background f path.

scope.actions: Local read-only inspection of the pinned inputs and primary PDFs; in-memory page rendering; this JSON is the only output file written. No subdelegation, publication, payment, credentials, ESTADO or other chat/repository update.

result.conclusion: For the original compatible masks and either original mean 0.4 or 0.12, at a fixed admitted real bare background with the original invertible selected pivots, the source shell lies farther from the inner incident free coordinates than the finite variable-slot range of Q_free. Consequently Q_DE P_S=0. On every actual shell section, Q_DE R_E(f a_E)=f Q_DE a_E. The proposed 8L+10 is safe padding, not an exponential estimate or a quoted source constant. No counterexample to this structural assertion was found under the actual masks.
result.consumer: The forcing and the Gaussian multipliers admit explicit smooth continuations in f independent of far-shell Log continuation; C_D and the covariance interpretation remain conditional on the declared positive definite real Q_D. This removes the particular multiplier-extension obstruction only.
adverse_or_limiting_findings: The input supplies no admitted full physical family or numerical background/precision witness.
The original mixed-data/localized-minimum construction is not admitted by a geometric support proof.
The density, its sections, Jacobians, outer action and endpoints remain independent obligations.
No full shell factor, conditional factorization, or normalized connected/history result follows.

source_masks.verified_displays: CMP119 printed 251 equation 1.20 was visually checked, not inferred from damaged OCR. With T_ell denoting addition of one layer of touching ell-cubes and E_ell(X)=(T_ell(X^c))^c, Lambda_pre=E_ell^2(Omega1) intersect (T_ell(R1_prime))^c, S1=(Omega1 minus E_ell(Omega1)) union R1. R1_prime is the union of ell-cubes intersecting R1. Here ell=LMR1 is on the original fine unit lattice.
source_masks.compatible_partitions: CMP119 printed 245-246 requires compatible partitions; R1 consists of L^2 M2 R1 cells, Omega1 and R1_prime use LMR1 cells. These are unions of whole first-level blocks. The tilde operation uses the cube family defining the set; no M2-scale tilde is silently substituted for the ell-scale erasures/enlargement in 1.20.
layer_proof: Use periodic macro-cube indices and the infinity graph metric, including face, edge and corner touching. For a macro cube a of E_ell^2(Omega1), its index distance to Omega1 complement is at least 3. A macro cube s of Omega1 minus E_ell(Omega1) has distance 1 to that complement. Hence their index distance is at least 2, leaving one entire ell-cube width between their continuous cube sets.
If a is outside T_ell(R1_prime), its index distance from every cube of R1_prime is at least 2. Since R1 is contained in R1_prime, its continuous distance to R1 is at least ell.

Combining the two shell parts gives dist_infinity(Lambda_pre,S1)>=ell. This reasoning uses the compatible continuous cube convention. It also works with periodic distances, and is vacuous if the relevant sets are empty.
source_masks.rectangular_modification: The source enlarges selected connected components of Lambda_pre complement to rectangular hulls containing them, still unions of ell-cubes. Thus Lambda_final is a subset of Lambda_pre. It cannot shorten the distance to the original S1. Newly removed inner cells enter E but do not automatically become shell-changed cells; S1 is not redefined as all of Lambda_final complement.
incident_free_dictionary: CMP119 printed 247 equation 1.9 explicitly uses bonds with at least one endpoint in X, excluding b0(c) for incident coarse c. This is not the set of bonds with both endpoints in X.

For a union of whole first-level blocks, a global pivot b0(c) is incident to X exactly when c is incident to the corresponding coarse X. Therefore X* equals global free bonds intersected with the incident fine set. This applies to both final Lambda1 and S1.

Let A be active independent fine bonds, beta(I) the original active selected bonds, and F=A minus beta(I). Then D=F intersect incident(Lambda_final), E=F minus D, and the changed set S=S1* is a subset of E. Inverse orientations are dependent and are not added as independent variables.

Each endpoint of a bond incident to a continuous region is at infinity distance at most 1 from that region. Thus for b in D and s in S, every endpoint pair is separated by at least ell-2. Using 2 fine units is conservative even if the chosen endpoint itself lies in the region. This explicitly pays the site/bond lift.
source_masks.shell_mask: CMP119 printed 251-252 changes only variables b in S1*. The guarded class is (R1 tilde^2 intersect S1)*; the unguarded class is S1* minus (R1 tilde^2)*. Both are contained in S1*. On every other free coordinate the map is identity. Assigning gamma=1 to every exterior coordinate would be a different, invalid mask.
source_masks.not_established: Nothing here validates the existence, correct exterior prescription, regularity or unique branch of the localized mixed-data configuration introduced around 1.21.

bare_precision_support.operator: Q_free=C_rec^sharp (A_W_second - K_Lambda + S_gauge^sharp W S_gauge) C_rec, with <v,K_Lambda w>=<Lambda,F_second[v,w]>. Background U1, current, multipliers, metrics, source mean version and active restrictions are fixed.
bare_precision_support.source_check: CMP119 printed 249 equations 1.14-1.16 directly give the first-step selected-only straightening and C lift, and the Wilson/current/gauge extracted quadratic. CMP109 printed 266 confirms G=1/2 G^(2)+G3 and D^(2)=C^(2), and printed 267 gives the rowwise selected inverse. This is a check of the source objects needed for slot locality, not an inherited validation of every claim in 1813.
bare_precision_support.mean_0_4: The paths Gamma and Gamma_prime remain in B(c_minus) and B(c_plus). The translated segment [x,x_prime] and the reference segment c cross only the interface of those two blocks. Both the inner Log and the outer exponential act on this finite set of group words. A fixed V_c in F_c adds no variable slot. Thus first and second derivatives of F_c have slots only in the same two blocks and their connecting links.
bare_precision_support.mean_0_12: The averaged root-contour variables use the same families of intrablock paths. The group average may be defined implicitly by a finite Lie-group mean, but its variable inputs are still only those paths in one block. The coarse row combines two such intrablock means, [x,x_prime] and c. It therefore has the same two-block slot carrier. An implicit inverse in the finite-dimensional group mean is not an inverse across coarse lattice rows.
selected_reconstruction: The only selected interblock bond in row c is its own b0(c). Intrablock paths cannot contain any selected interblock pivot, and the translated/reference crossing bonds have the same endpoint-block pair as c.

Consequently P restricted to selected columns is diagonal by coarse row, with a Lie-algebra matrix block per row. On an admitted branch, C_rec a is a on all free rows and its b0(c) row is minus the inverse of the local pivot coefficient times that row applied to its free inputs. No inverse of a coupled lattice operator is inserted.

CMP119 printed 249 explicitly describes A_prime(b0(c)) as a linear function of remaining variables in the two endpoint blocks, and CMP109 printed 267 describes h(c) as the inverse local coefficient. Restricting active variables or fixing exterior inputs removes slots; it cannot add distant ones.
bare_precision_support.wilson_primitive: A second derivative of one Wilson plaquette term uses the four plaquette links. Replacing any selected plaquette link by C_rec uses the endpoint blocks of that same link. Those are among the blocks meeting the plaquette. A fine plaquette meets at most four adjacent first-level blocks, in a two-by-two arrangement in its two directions, so the free-slot carrier remains in their union.
bare_precision_support.constraint_current_primitive: Each term <Lambda_c,F_c_second> remains supported in the row c two-block carrier after C_rec, because its only selected pivot is b0(c), whose reconstruction uses the same two blocks. Lambda_c may depend nonlocally on background data but is a fixed coefficient. The equivalent contraction <J,h C^(2)> has the same slot support. The current is retained, not set to zero.
bare_precision_support.gauge_primitive: The original averaged root paths lie inside one block. The original gauge is a sum of row trace norms, as seen in CMP119 1.7 and CMP109 0.11, 0.14, 2.5. Its Hessian is the sum of S_gauge_row^sharp W_row S_gauge_row. The trace weights are in the Lie indices within each row and do not connect distinct spatial rows. Intrablock gauge paths contain no selected interblock pivot. Thus these primitives have one-block slot carriers.
bare_precision_support.range_verdict: A two-by-two union of blocks has fine-coordinate extent at most 2L in each direction; allowing an additional fine layer for endpoints still gives at most 2L+2. Even the deliberately looser carrier bound 4L+4 is smaller than 8L+10. Hence whenever a free-free matrix entry of this Q_free is nonzero, its bond endpoints lie within the conservative range R_Q=8L+10. No cancellation or exponential-decay estimate is used, and the value 8L+10 is an assessment bound, not a number printed in the papers.
strict_scope: This is the bare first-step extracted precision before nonlinear shell composition. It is not the inverse precision, the conditional covariance, or a later effective action with H1/history kernels.
CMP109 general later-step formulas do contain extended background operators; those formulas are not substituted for the direct first-step CMP119 formula.
It is not the Hessian of the complete finite-g0 log density including all Haar and nonlinear Jacobian terms.
Nonlocal dependence of coefficients on U1 or V does not change support in variable fluctuation slots. Derivatives varying the background are a separate question.
Changing the original mean to an unspecified axiomatic averaging operation, changing W to a spatially coupled metric, or using a different selected elimination requires a new support proof.

scale_check.premises: L is odd and >11; 1<=M1<M2<M; M2=L^m2 and M=L^m with distinct integer exponents; R1>=1. These are the fixed input/source conditions. No power condition on M1 is used.
derivation: M2>1 and M2 is a power of L imply m2>=1 and M2>=L.
M>M2 with integral exponents implies m>=m2+1, so M>=L M2>=L^2.
Therefore ell=LMR1>=L^3. For L>11, L^3>8L+12=R_Q+2. In the smallest allowed odd case L=13, the lower bound is 2197 versus 116. This is a bound, not a newly selected physical parameter tuple.
The shell bond gap is ell-2>R_Q. Also L^2 M2 R1<=LMR1, compatible with the actual source nesting.
not_used: M1 being a power of L
a new choice of M or g0
smallness of the actual shell displacement
scale_check.limits: This pays only the finite-range geometric inequality. The source has additional regularity, smallness and simultaneous scale conditions; their satisfaction for the unchanged law is not established by this inequality.

zero_coupling_and_forcing.projection_definition: P_S is the coordinate projection in E onto the actual changed free coordinates S=S1*. All injections and sharps use the original repeated Lie pairings. It is not a projection onto every exterior bond or onto a continuum shell without the free-bond exclusion.
zero_coupling_and_forcing.proof: For d in D and s in S, the incident-bond gap is ell-2>R_Q. The bare range proof therefore gives (Q_free)_(d,s)=0 entry by entry, hence Q_DE P_S=0. This is an exact structural zero. It does not require Q_D positivity.
path: On an actual admitted shell section write r_f=f a_E+delta_f, with delta_f supported in S. Then Q_DE r_f=f Q_DE a_E. The same statement at f=1 gives Q_DE R_E(a_E)=Q_DE a_E.
Where R_E is differentiable along the section, Q_DE r_dot_f=Q_DE a_E. No derivative of the far-shell Log is needed to evaluate this product.

Even if different admitted far-shell branches give different delta_f, the forcing agrees, provided the map is identity on all non-shell free slots. This does not identify or merge the corresponding density branches.
At f=0 the full r_0 can be nonzero and may require a local Log, but its coupling into D is zero. One must not replace all exterior physical fields by U1 or raw V0.

global_multiplier_extension.conditional_inverse: If the fixed real Q_D is positive definite, set C_D=Q_D^-1 and j=Q_DE a_E.
global_multiplier_extension.continuation: These formulas define smooth multipliers on all f in [0,1] for fixed finite data and agree with the direct ones wherever the shell section exists. They define no R_E, N or density off its true section. At 0, j_0=0 and p_0=1; z_0 generally does not vanish.
global_multiplier_extension.empty_D: Use the zero-dimensional convention, determinant 1 and empty forcing, while retaining every exterior factor.

zero_coupling_and_forcing.reference_comparison: The inner part -<a_D,Q_DE(r_f-f a_E)> of the direct-versus-chosen-reference correction vanishes. Their p factors now coincide because their j factors coincide. The outer correction -1/2[<r_f,Q_EE r_f>-f^2<a_E,Q_EE a_E>] remains unless separately shown to vanish. If allocated into a shell remainder, retain it there exactly once.
no_factorization: Q_DE on other exterior coordinates is generally nonzero, so j need not vanish.
C_D can have long range and z can extend through D; finite range of Q_free is not finite range of its inverse.
No statement about covariance of the full truncated interacting conditional law follows.
The full shell action and full normalizers do not become 1.

specific_wilson_words1850.geometry_rechecked: Take r=(L-1)/2 and the block pair in the 1850 input only when it actually occurs at final Lambda1 boundary. The crossing links b1 and b3 have transverse coordinate 3 equal to 1, whereas the central selected corridor has all transverse coordinates 0. The two other links are intrablock. All four are free. By incident convention b1,b3,b4 belong to D and b2 to E. The second plaquette at (L,1,1,0) in directions 2,3 lies wholly inside the neighboring exterior block because r>=6, and all four links are intrablock free links.
specific_wilson_words1850.shell_placement: The exterior b2 is within a fine step of the boundary block. All links of the second plaquette are within L+2 of that inside block. Since any S1* link is at least ell-2 from D and ell>=L^3, these particular exterior free links cannot belong to S1*. This placement follows from the final actual geometry, not from assigning them a shell class.
specific_wilson_words1850.links: For these exterior slots R_E(f a_E)_b=f a_b exactly, so L_b(f)=exp(i g0 f a_b)U1_b and L_b(0)=U1_b. Their exact right velocity is i g0 a_b. This is the identity part of the shell map, not the unguarded gamma=1 shell transformation.
specific_wilson_words1850.crossing_transport: The inner free factors retain the velocities -i g0 integral_0^1 Ad_exp(i s g0 a_b)(z_b) ds under partial_f-z dot grad_aD, with the now constant z=C_D j if Q_D>0. The exterior crossing-factor velocity remains i g0 a_b. The exterior contact term in the ordered word derivative remains present.
remaining_limits: The exterior plaquette word is independent of a_D, but depends on f through its exterior free variables and can have nonzero c_q_prime. Its contact contribution cannot be discarded.
A location entirely in the active exterior is not the prescribed raw V0 region. At f=0 these particular links equal U1_b, which need not be identity or a vacuum configuration.
The conclusion applies to the two complete free-bond words stated in 1850 without extra root or frame paths. Added paths or selected links need their own support check.
If the declared neighboring block pair does not occur in an actual source sector, the example is absent. This assessment does not construct a physical instance.
N and C_rec leave these free coordinates unchanged, but selected reconstruction still matters elsewhere in the density.

remaining_gates.detail: Existence and regularity of the fixed U1 and the actual mean/Log branch, constrained criticality, surjective row derivative, and invertibility of the original selected coefficient must hold at the chosen data. The source asserts relevant theorems, but their full hypotheses and proof are not audited here. No full K_C coverage is proved.

The support mask does not prove that the 1.21 configuration exists with the required boundary/exterior prescription or that its H has the assumed regularity. Earlier unadmitted boundary issues remain unadmitted. The effective H normalization is not resolved or altered by a support zero; its actual units must be retained in all surviving shell factors.

Q_DE P_S=0 is independent of positivity, but C_D, normalized Gaussian formulas and the proposed transport as a Gaussian operation require the declared real Q_D>0. No gap, inverse bound, or transfer from an old hard/axial source covariance is provided. The printed minimum statement is not itself a checked all-family certificate.

remaining_gates.gate: Definition and integrability of section density
remaining_gates.detail: The original density must be defined on its actual source section before zero extension. Smooth j,p,g,z do not define an off-chart N or a missing shell Jacobian. Coefficientwise joint local L1 in (f,a_D), and any outer integrability needed for interchange, remain to be proved.

The unexpanded zero-extended density can only be differentiated as a distribution when its integrability is established. Splitting this derivative into bulk, moving-section and cutoff surfaces requires the corresponding trace/product hypotheses. Absolute continuity or an appropriate endpoint theorem and actual endpoint traces are needed for an integral FTC formula. The multiplier continuation alone supplies none of these.

Retain Q_EE outer action and its f derivative, R_E and its Jacobian, all other L_shell/V^(0)(S1) allocations, selected N and Haar/nonlinear Jacobian factors, original K and other cutoffs, background/sector labels, O_dot, baseline factors, all Gaussian determinants and p conversion to the uncompensated contribution, and the full fixed-law normalizers.

LAW1535/1559 remain unchanged, including fixed C_delta, beta_ref, source prefactor discrepancy and ordering restrictions. The source hierarchy pays this one range inequality only; no coupling window, simultaneous absorption, source-family regularity or all-history conclusion is proved.

A conditional free-word identity and a smooth inner forcing do not commute away exterior/background/sector integration, normalized logarithms, connected sums or history dependence. These operations and their nonvanishing/analyticity/integrability requirements remain outside this result.

The conclusion uses fixed masks, U1, P, h, C_rec, Q and source H data while evaluating the outer free variables at f a_E. Re-minimizing U1, varying the source geometry, changing g0, or moving a branch label with f beyond the prescribed section requires extra derivative terms and is not covered.

falsifiers.test: A visual source reading yields a different sign or number of ell-layers in 1.20, or only face-neighbor erasure rather than a layer of touching cubes.
falsifiers.effect: The continuous ell gap proof must be redone and may fail. The pinned displays inspected here support the stated layers.

falsifiers.test: Rectangular modification adds sites to Lambda1, or redefines S1 as all of the new exterior.
falsifiers.effect: The monotonic separation or shell support premise fails. The pinned source enlarges the complement and retains the original S1.

falsifiers.test: An allegedly shell-changed free bond lies outside S1*, or an identity exterior coordinate is assigned the gamma=1 transformation.
falsifiers.effect: Q_DE P_S=0 for the source S no longer controls the actual displacement; linear forcing may fail.

falsifiers.test: Use a both-endpoints-inside partition, delete independent crossing bonds, retain selected bonds as free, double-count inverse orientations, or use a non-whole-block region.
falsifiers.effect: The D/E and source-star dictionary is no longer the one verified here. Recompute the masks rather than importing the conclusion.

falsifiers.test: A row of mean 0.4/0.12 or a gauge contour uses variable links outside its stated endpoint block(s).
falsifiers.effect: The derivative carrier must be enlarged. The displayed path definitions inspected here have no such link.

falsifiers.test: The actual selected matrix couples distinct coarse rows, a selected inverse is singular, or C_rec is replaced by a global propagator.
falsifiers.effect: The local selected lift either does not exist or can have longer range, invalidating the stated bound.

falsifiers.test: The precision includes nonlocal effective-action/history terms, a spatially off-diagonal gauge weight, or a background response varied with the fluctuation slots.
falsifiers.effect: It is not the fixed bare Q_free assessed here; long-range entries may survive.

falsifiers.test: M2 or M is not the specified integral power of L, they are not distinct in the stated order, R1<1, or incompatible lattices/scales are used.
falsifiers.effect: The supplied scale inequality is not available. M1 being a power is neither required nor a repair.

falsifiers.test: Exhibit d in actual D and s in actual S1* with nonzero Q_free(d,s), despite their verified gap and the displayed bare local reconstruction.
falsifiers.effect: This directly falsifies the zero-coupling conclusion and identifies an omitted carrier, mask or operator term.

falsifiers.test: On one admitted source section, R_E(f a_E)-f a_E has a non-shell free component, or Q/U1/masks vary along f.
falsifiers.effect: The forcing proof no longer applies; direct nonlinear or coefficient-derivative terms must be retained.

falsifiers.test: Q_D is singular or not positive definite in the declared real metric.
falsifiers.effect: The support zero may still hold, but the asserted positive Gaussian covariance/normalization/transport package is unavailable as stated.

falsifiers.test: Use the smooth multiplier extension to assign a density off its chart, discard density/section jumps, omit cutoff surfaces, or apply endpoint FTC without traces/absolute continuity.
falsifiers.effect: This is an unsupported globalization even though the multiplier extension itself is valid.

falsifiers.test: Remove the Q_EE correction, JR, other shell terms, selected/Haar factors, O_dot, source normalizers, or the p conversion.
falsifiers.effect: The resulting integral is not the original physical contribution.

falsifiers.test: One chosen 1850 word has a selected link, an extra variable frame path, a different boundary incidence, or an exterior factor actually in S1*.
falsifiers.effect: Its simplified insertion/velocity formula requires correction. The two precisely specified plaquettes pass the stated geometry check.

falsifiers.test: Call all f=0 exterior fields U1/vacuum, declare c_q_prime=0, or infer full conditional or physical connected factorization.
falsifiers.effect: These claims are false in general and are not consequences of the support result.

verification_limits.reading_level: Primary definitions and selected displayed equations were checked through extracted text and the listed page images. No full proof audit of either paper was performed.
verification_limits.numerical_or_formal_certificate: No instantiated physical background matrix, exhaustive sector computation, formal proof assistant theorem or build was supplied or run. The report gives a structural mathematical argument from the actual source definitions.
verification_limits.unread_upstream_material: References nested inside the six premise inputs, including earlier assessments, hard-source papers and 1806/1808 material, were not inherited as validated premises and were not reopened. Their admission claims are not certified here.
verification_limits.counterexample_search: Checked actual layer signs, rectangular monotonicity, both shell classes, incident/free masks, two mean definitions, local pivot elimination, current and gauge terms, parameter exponents and the concrete Wilson placement. No counterexample found within these objects; general alternative means/operators/geometries are explicitly excluded.
verification_limits.not_a_full_closure: Only the exact bare shell-to-inner forcing and its Gaussian multiplier continuation have been supported. Physical/source admission and the complete integral remain open.
